meta.title: የእሷ እርምጃ
meta.logline: A girl walks out of an arranged marriage into the dark highlands, and the step she takes becomes the road her granddaughter stands on.
meta.audience: My family first, on a phone: my mother's generation, who knew her, and my cousins born in Addis and abroad who only know her name. Then the cohort and anyone who has a grandmother they wish they had asked more questions about.
meta.intent: They should feel that one frightened, barefoot decision is the reason their own life exists where it does, and they should want to go and ask an elder for the story they have not asked for yet.

consent.details: Subject is my late grandmother. Her living children (including my parent) have been asked and have agreed, and the record is in ETHICS.md. Consent covers (a) a stylised painted depiction informed by the one surviving family photograph, (b) the invented first-person words placed in her mouth, and (c) publication to the course and to social platforms with an AI label. Her photograph is a likeness reference only; it is never shown on screen and she is not named in the film or its public posts.

narration.text: በዚያች ሌሊት ዕድሜዬ ገና አልቆጠረም ነበር።
narration.subtitle: That night, I had not yet counted my years.

shots.ambience: muffled drums through a wall, fire crackle, a woman's laugh far off

shots.reason: The emotional centre of the opening: one tear in lamplight turns a dressed-up child into someone who understands what is happening to her.

narration.text: እጆቼ በእንሶስላ ሲቀሉ፣ ልቤ ግን በፍርሃት ታስሮ ነበር።
narration.subtitle: My hands were stained with henna, but my heart was tied in fear.

shots.ambience: breath, lamp hiss, drum far away

shots.reason: Names the thing being done to her without showing a face: the elder's shadow on the wall is the whole institution of 'it is your fate'.
shots.camera: low angle on the wall, static

narration.text: ያልመረጥኩትን ሕይወት፣ ያላወቅኩትን ባል... ‹ዕድልሽ ነው› ብለው ሊያሸክሙኝ ድግሱ ደምቋል።
narration.subtitle: They had lit the wedding fires to load me with a life I did not choose, a husband I did not know — "it is your fate," they said.

shots.ambience: approaching footsteps, drum, ululation rising then cut

shots.reason: The decision as an image rather than a line: a small figure already outside, fog closing over the road behind her.
shots.motion: fog rolls slowly across the ridge, the edge of her shawl lifts in the wind, camera tracks gently beside her at walking speed

narration.text: ግን ደግሞ ከፍርሃቴ ይልቅ የነጻነት ጥማቴ በረታ።
narration.subtitle: But a thirst for freedom grew louder than my fear.

shots.ambience: wind, wet gravel underfoot, one dog barking far away

shots.reason: The cost of the decision, made physical: this is what running actually feels like, and it keeps the film from romanticising her.

narration.text: የታሰረብኝን የባህል ገመድ በጥሼ፣ ጨለማውን ተገን አድርጌ ተነሳሁ።
narration.subtitle: I tore the rope of custom that bound me and made the darkness my cloak.

shots.reason: The shawl is the one object that carries her old life; leaving it on the path is the vow, said without narration.

narration.subtitle: The thorn cut my feet, the stone bruised me...

shots.motion: diesel smoke drifts and thins above the road, fog moves slowly through the valley, the tiny figure does not move, camera holds perfectly still

narration.text: ከኋላዬ ካለው እስር ቤት ይልቅ ከፊቴ ያለው ያልታወቀ መንገድ ናፈቀኝ።

shots.ambience: wind over open ground, distant engine, one bird

shots.reason: The hard cut from fog to gold is the whole film's turn; it must be a shock of light, and she must be small in it rather than triumphant.
